LESSON: ORDERING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Pre- Number Activities
Topic 1.3: Ordering
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ordering, part of Pre- Number Activities in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How can you arrange play objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect play objects in the school neighbourhood and observe safety. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to collect play objects while those mobility difficulties should observe safety as they move in different terrain. Safety precaution should be observed by all learners.

2. Talk about different play objects in the school neighborhood in relation to size. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) as they share their ideas.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect play objects in the school neighbourhood and observe safety. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to collect play objects while those mobility difficulties should observe safety as they move in different terrain. Safety precaution should be observed by all learners.
2. Talk about different play objects in the school neighborhood in relation to size. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) as they share their ideas.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ordering together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: learners work with one another to order play objects according to size in ascending and descending manner.

Values:
Unity: learners work amicably cooperate to accomplish the task on ordering play objects according to size in ascending and

descending manner.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: learners carefully collect play objects for ordering from the school neighbourhood.

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate new vocabulary in ordering different play objects to reading skills in Language Activities
